description: This file implements a React component called WorkflowsTable, which displays a list of workflows in a virtualized, scrollable table with features such as sorting, selecting, deleting workflows, and displaying detailed workflow info via hover cards. It utilizes various UI components for layout and interaction, and integrates with workflow services for deletion operations.

methods.name: SortableHeaderCell
methods.description: A React component for sortable table header cells that toggles sort direction on click.

methods.name: RelativeTime
methods.description: Renders a relative time string based on a timestamp.

methods.name: WorkflowHoverCard
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a workflow in a hover card layout.

methods.name: WorkflowVCStatusCell
methods.description: Displays the VC verification status badge for a workflow, or a skeleton/loading placeholder.

methods.name: LoadingRow
methods.description: A placeholder row displayed during loading states.

methods.name: EmptyState
methods.description: A component shown when there are no workflows to display.

methods.name: WorkflowsTable
methods.description: Main component that renders a virtualized, sortable, selectable table of workflows with actions and detailed info.
